_what: MCHOSE destructive-path inventory, TICKET-25 consolidation item 7
_rule: UNKNOWN is never promoted to SAFE. A path nobody has explained is not a path nobody needs to explain.
_families_are_not_merged: Five families are tracked separately and no rule crosses between them: keyboard/BY, keyboard/CZ, mouse receiver, AA-55 OTA on report id 77, and the CZ SDK envelope. A classification established in one says nothing about another. AULA contributes nothing to any of them.
_no_destructive_path_found: NOT ISSUED for any family. Coverage is far from complete and that verdict over incomplete coverage describes the walk, not the device (trap O-4).

structural_finding.claim: a CZ read and a CZ write of all-zero payload are BYTE-IDENTICAL
structural_finding.why: byte 4 carries 'bytes requested' in _simpleGetCommand and 'bytes supplied' in _simpleFullSendCommand; the frame does not distinguish them
structural_finding.consequence: direction is UNKNOWN for every CZ frame, so no CZ frame can be classified SAFE_READ on shape alone
structural_finding.same_shape_as: the BY wired-0x04 ambiguity — two independent families, two independent instances of the same trap
structural_finding.asymmetry: The inference runs one way only. The vendor's read builder never places bytes after the 8-byte header, so a non-zero trailing region proves a WRITE. An all-zero trailing region proves nothing, because a read and a write of zeros are byte-identical.

identity_safety.note: 33 of the 66 resolved identities are the DFU interface. Selecting one makes the app offer a firmware update. Nothing was sent to any of them; the oracle now refuses to run against one (assert_not_boot_identity), because driving DFU by accident is both an empty-capture trap and a foot-gun.
